```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
library(stringr)


data <- read.csv("curatedDataForPublication.csv") %>% 
  rename("p" = "X.p") %>% 
  mutate(N = as.numeric(N)) %>% 
  mutate(Rsquared = as.numeric(Rsquared)) %>% 
  mutate(ChiSq = as.numeric(ChiSq)) %>% 
  mutate(Gstatistic = as.numeric(Gstatistic)) %>% 
  mutate(tStatistic = as.numeric(Tstatistic)) %>% 
  mutate(Fstatistic = as.numeric(Fstatistic)) %>% 
  mutate(dfnum = as.numeric(dfnum)) %>% 
  mutate(dfdenom = as.numeric(dfdenom)) %>% 
  select(-c(Lreduced, Lfull)) %>% 
  mutate(N = if_else((!is.na(dfnum) & !is.na(dfdenom)), dfnum+dfdenom+1, N)) %>% #N did not always match df
  filter(p != "NS") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(p)) %>% 
  mutate(pValNumericOnly = as.numeric(p)) %>% 
  mutate(p_num = extract_numeric(p)) %>% 
  filter(!DOI %in% c("https://doi.org/10.1016/j.anbehav.2018.12.014")) %>%  #Not sure what happened to this paper but need to remove it
   filter(Title != "Social ontogeny in the communication system of an insect") #multiple moi for each stat
length(unique(data$Title))

dt
```



## Calculate Likelihood Ratios
```{r}
dt <- data.table(data)

dt[, `:=` ( 
    Likelihood = fcase(
    !is.na(Rsquared) & !is.na(N), (1 - Rsquared) ^ (-N / 2),
    !is.na(Gstatistic), exp(Gstatistic / 2),
    !is.na(ChiSq), exp(ChiSq / 2),
    !is.na(tStatistic) & !is.na(N), (1 + (tStatistic ^ 2) / (N - 2)) ^ (N / 2),
    !is.na(Fstatistic) & !is.na(dfnum) * !is.na(dfdenom), (1 + Fstatistic * (dfnum / dfdenom)) ^ (N / 2)
    ),
    
    TypeStat = fcase(
    !is.na(Rsquared), "Rsquared",
    !is.na(Gstatistic), "ChiSq/G",
    !is.na(ChiSq), "ChiSq/G",
    !is.na(tStatistic), "tStatistic",
    !is.na(Fstatistic), "Fstatistic"
    )
    
)]

length(unique(dt$Title))

dt

dt %>% 
  filter(!is.na(LR))
```




# Flagging Duplicates
```{r}

duplicateTrue <- function(e, b, f, a) {
  print("i")
  
}

dt %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(nTrue = length(which(c(Evidentialist, Bayesian, Frequentist) == "TRUE"))) %>% 
  filter(Title != "Social ontogeny in the communication system of an insect") %>% 
  filter(nTrue > 1)
  
```


## Now need to get text into true/ false cols
```{r}

duplicate <- dt %>% 
  select(DOI, Title, TypeStat, Evidentialist, Frequentist, Bayesian, Likelihood, pValNumericOnly) %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(tCount = str_count(string = paste(TypeStat, Evidentialist, Frequentist, Bayesian), pattern = "TRUE")) %>% 
  filter(tCount > 1)

unique(duplicate$Title)
  
```

## Changes Over Time
```{r}
overTime <- dt %>%
  filter(Journal != "") %>% 
  mutate(Frequentist = if_else(Type == "Frequentist", TRUE, Frequentist)) %>% 
  mutate(Evidentialist = if_else(Type == "Evidentialist", TRUE, Evidentialist)) %>% 
  group_by(Year)


overTime2 <- overTime %>% 
  summarize(#AIC = sum(AIC, na.rm = TRUE),
             Bayesian = sum(Bayesian, na.rm = TRUE),
             Frequentist = sum(Frequentist, na.rm = TRUE),
             Evidentialist = sum(Evidentialist, na.rm = TRUE)) 
overTime2
sum(overTime2$Frequentist)
```
```{r}
dt %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Likelihood))

rationale <- dt %>% 
 group_by(Title) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Rationale)) %>% 
  summarize(RatTrue = sum(Rationale, na.omit = TRUE))

sum(rationale$RatTrue)

rationale

```

```{r}
threshold <- dt %>% 
  mutate(pRange = if_else(grepl(">", p) | grepl("<", p), 1, 0)) %>% 
  mutate(index = 1) %>% 
  filter(Journal != "") %>% 
  group_by(Journal, Year) %>% 
  summarize(`Percent Threshold Values` = round(100*sum(pRange)/sum(index), digits= 2)) 
```
```{r}
ggplot(threshold, aes (x = as.factor(Year), y = `Percent Threshold Values`, fill = Journal)) + 
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Issue Year") + 
  theme(legend.key.spacing.y = unit(0.2, "cm")) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(labels = c("Animal Behaviour", "Biological \nConservation", "Canadian Journal of \nFisheries and Aquatic \nSciences", "Landscape Ecology", "Marine Ecology \nProgress Series"))
```


## Different way of duplictae flaging
```{r}

    mutate(Type2 = case_when(Evidentialist & !Bayesian & !Frequentist & !AIC~ "Evidentialist",

                           Frequentist & !Evidentialist & !Bayesian & !AIC ~ "Frequentist",
                           AIC & !Evidentialist & !Bayesian & !Frequentist ~ "AIC")) %>% 
  mutate(Type = if_else(Type == "", Type2, Type)) #%>%
```

# Fig 1 Plot
```{r}
InfCutoff <- 10**1000000
zeroCutoff = 10**-1000000

loglogzoomed10 <- dt %>% 
  filter(pValNumericOnly > zeroCutoff) %>% 
  mutate(dfRatio = dfnum/dfdenom) %>% 
  mutate(roundedLR = round(Likelihood, digits = 2)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(color = TypeStat, shape = TypeStat, label1 = Title, label2 = pValNumericOnly, label3 = roundedLR, label4 = N, label5 = dfnum, label6 = dfdenom))+ 
  theme_bw() +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "gray40") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log(0.05, base = 10), linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey60") +
 # geom_vline(xintercept = log(100, base = 10), linetype = "dotted", colour = "red") +
  ylim(0, 4.25) +
  geom_point(aes(log(Likelihood, base = 10), -log(pValNumericOnly, base = 10))) +
  scale_colour_grey() +
  labs(color  = "Test", shape  = "Test") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) format(x, scientific = FALSE)) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) format(x, scientific = FALSE)) +
 # xlim(0, 60) +
  labs(x = "log(LR)", y = "-log(p)", title = "")

# scale_color_manual(values = c("#332288", "#88CCEE", "#44AA99")) +#Tol color pallete
  #facet_wrap(.~measure)
loglogzoomed10

#library(plotly)
#ggplotly(loglogzoomed10)
loglogzoomed10 +
  xlim(0, 6)
```

## F stat df
```{r}
library(viridis)
fStat <- dt %>% 
  filter(log(pValNumericOnly, base = 10) < InfCutoff) %>% 
  filter(TypeStat == "Fstatistic") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(dfdenom) | !is.na(dfnum)) %>% 
  mutate(dfRatio = dfnum/dfdenom) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(color = log(dfRatio, base = 10), size = dfnum, label1 = Title, label2 = pValNumericOnly, label3 = round(Likelihood, 2), label4 = N, label5 = dfnum, label6 = dfdenom))+ 
  theme_bw() +
  #ylim(0, 4.25) +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "gray40") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log(0.05, base = 10), linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey60") +
  geom_point(aes(log(Likelihood, base = 10), -log(pValNumericOnly, base = 10))) +
  scale_colour_viridis() +
  labs(color  = "Df numerator/\nDf denominator", size = "Df numerator", x = "log(LR)", y = "-log(p)", title = "") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) format(x, scientific = FALSE)) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) format(x, scientific = FALSE))# +
  #xlim(0, 60) 

fStat
```
